name: Will my insurance cover storm damage repairs identified during an assessment?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover storm damage repairs identified during an assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance coverage for storm damage typically depends on your specific policy. Most homeowner policies cover sudden and accidental damage from perils like wind and hail, but exclusions and deductibles apply. A professional assessment provides the necessary documentation to support your claim. Discounted Roofing Co. can help homeowners navigate the insurance claim process by providing detailed reports and communicating with adjusters.
